Subject: Clarification Required for Fixture Connections

We are preparing the domestic water branch connections and need confirmation of the required connection size and valve arrangement for the fixtures referenced in the current installation package. The information available to our crew does not identify the applicable fixture schedule, drawing number, or specification section.
